name: Yellow Wheel Ceramics
tagline: Wheel-thrown stoneware and porcelain, made slowly in a small studio.
heroText: Bowls, mugs, vases and plates thrown on the wheel, glazed by hand, and fired in small batches. Each piece is one of a kind.
studioVisits: Studio visits are by appointment. Send a note and we will find a time.
shortBio: Elena has been throwing pots for over a decade. Her work is rooted in functional ware: the bowl you reach for every morning, the mug that fits your hands. Surfaces come from a small palette of ash, iron and feldspar glazes tested and retested in her own kiln.
